title: Component Orchestra: Thematic Token Playbook for Nested Metric Panels
creator: Maya Ortiz
description: Goal: Define a consistent, responsive set of tokens and component choreography for nested metric panels (cards that contain small charts, KPIs, and rollout controls) so product teams can assemble dashboards without ad-hoc overrides. Background: Multiple product pods have implemented slightly different density, spacing and micro-interaction rules for metric panels leading to visual drift and inconsistent cost/rollout controls. Scope: 1) Token palette (spacing, elevation, type scale, accent ramps) for compact/regular/expanded density. 2) Figma component library with boolean props (dense, interactive, has-annotation) and motion specs. 3) Naming scheme and migration guide for developers and existing DF components. 4) Accessibility guardrails for contrast, focus states, and keyboard affordances. Deliverables: Figma library file, tokens JSON export, migration checklist, example dashboard prototype, and rollout playbook describing how to ship incremental surface changes with minimal user disruption. Constraints: Maintain existing metric-card API contract in code; avoid breaking changes to telemetry events; preserve console-performance budgets for initial paint (<250ms on common dev machines). Acceptance criteria: - Figma library published with documented tokens and 3 example card variants - Frontend engineers can implement using token names without custom CSS - QA passes accessibility checklist (contrast, keyboard) - Rollout plan approved by PM and Eng leads.
